Job Description
Looking for Central Kitchen chefs @Pandan Loop (Be part of the best bakery team!)
Up to $2,500 Completion Bonus (Terms and Conditions Applied)
05 Days 44 Hours Work week
$2200 -$3200
If you want to perfect your Viennoiserie, Pastry, or Sourdough making skills, our Central Kitchen is the perfect place. If you have aspirations to move into management we can also help you take the next step in your career. We offer world-class bakery training to build our teams' knowledge, and being part of the Spa Esprit Group also means that there is an opportunity for promotion and growth across the company to our sister restaurant brands.
We are on the lookout for a range of Bakery Team Member roles:
Viennoiserie Team Members
Pastry Team Members
Bread Team Membeer
Savoury Hot Kitchen Team Members
We're passionate to develop our people to create the next generation of leaders by training and promoting from within. We love to take people with no experience who are passionate to learn.
Our people aren't robots, we empower people to be themselves, and let their personalities, ideas, and creativity shine. We take care of our people, we work hard to understand our team members as individuals to set everyone up for success. We build high-performing teams by creating courageous leaders, trusted relationships and training our teams to be knowledgeable and confident in their roles. Our team supports each other, looks after each other and works together to achieve our goals.

About the Company
The best French bakery in Singapore
Tiong Bahru Bakery is more than a great bakery, it’s a Singapore institution. With a reputation for serving the finest croissants in Asia, made fresh throughout the day with all French butter and French flour, TBB also serves the best coffee, savoury snacks, juices and teas.
